meta.title: Accessibility
meta.description: The accessibility declaration of the Bloctel portal.

hero.title: Accessibility declaration
hero.lead: The Bloctel is committed to making its portal accessible, in accordance with the law of 8 July 2019. This declaration applies to the Bloctel portal.

declaration.title: Our commitment
declaration.lead: The Bloctel is committed to digital accessibility to make its portal usable by everyone, whatever the disability, device or connection.

paragraphs.p1: Digital accessibility means making content and services accessible to all, in particular to people with disabilities. It is an issue of equal opportunity and a public service commitment.
paragraphs.p2: The Bloctel portal is built according to the general accessibility improvement framework (RGAA), to offer a consistent browsing experience to all visitors.

conformite.title: Compliance status
conformite.lead: The Bloctel portal is partially compliant with the general accessibility improvement framework (RGAA), version 4.1, level AA.

bullets.b1: Keyboard and touch navigation is supported on all pages.
bullets.b2: Text content respects the contrast and legibility rules defined by the framework.
bullets.b3: Some advanced interactive components remain to be harmonised with the framework recommendations.

nonAccessibles.title: Non-accessible content
nonAccessibles.lead: Despite our vigilance, some content may present access difficulties. The following items are not yet accessible:

bullets.b1: Documents published in PDF format before the entry into force of this declaration.
bullets.b2: Some data charts and visualisations, for which a text alternative is planned.
bullets.b3: A few videos without a full transcript, currently being processed.

etablissement.title: Establishment of this declaration
etablissement.lead: This declaration was established on 12 September 2026.

tests.label: Tests carried out
tests.value: Audit performed on a representative sample of portal pages

outils.label: Tools and methods
outils.value: Keyboard navigation, screen readers, automated contrast checking

retour.title: Feedback and contact
retour.lead: If you encounter an accessibility issue that prevents you from accessing a content or a service of the portal, you can report it to us:

paragraphs.p1: Write to us via the Contact page, specifying the nature of the problem and the page concerned. We commit to responding within five working days.

voiesRecours.title: Remedies
voiesRecours.lead: If you have not received a satisfactory response to your report, you can refer the matter to:

bullets.b1: The Defender of Rights, which can be contacted online or by post.
bullets.b2: The departmental conciliation commission or the competent court.
bullets.b3: Any procedure provided for by the law of 8 July 2019 and its implementing decree.

meta.title: Privacy
meta.description: The privacy policy of the Bloctel portal: personal data, purposes and rights.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.lead: The Bloctel pays particular attention to the protection of personal data. This policy explains which data the portal processes, why, and what rights you have.

responsable.title: Data controller
responsable.lead: The personal data processing operations carried out on the portal are under the responsibility of the Bloctel.

paragraphs.p1: For any question relating to the protection of your personal data, you can contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at the address below.

donnees.title: Data collected
donnees.lead: The portal collects a minimal volume of data, limited to what is strictly necessary for the operation of the service.

bullets.b1: Browsing data: IP address, pages visited, browser and screen resolution, for audience measurement and security purposes.
bullets.b2: Platform identification data: login, email address and preferences, only for authenticated services.
bullets.b3: Declarative data: what you voluntarily enter in a portal form.
bullets.b4: No payment data, banking data or sensitive data is processed by the public portal.

finalites.title: Purposes and legal bases
finalites.lead: Each processing operation on the portal pursues a defined purpose and relies on a legal basis.

paragraphs.p1: Audience measurement relies on the user's consent, collected via the cookie management banner. Processing operations related to the security of the portal fall within the public service mission of the Central Bank.
paragraphs.p2: Processing operations related to authenticated services rely on the performance of the public service mission or, where applicable, on a contract or explicit consent.

conservation.title: Retention period
conservation.lead: Data is kept only for as long as necessary for the purpose pursued.

duree.label: Retention period
duree.value: Limited periods defined for each processing operation

critere.label: Criterion
critere.value: Necessity of the purpose, legal time limits and applicable limitation

droits.title: Your rights
droits.lead: In accordance with the applicable regulations, you have rights over your personal data:

bullets.b1: Right of access, rectification and erasure of your data.
bullets.b2: Right to restriction of and objection to processing.
bullets.b3: Right to data portability of the data you have provided.
bullets.b4: Right to withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
bullets.b5: Right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority.

cookies.title: Cookies and audience measurement
cookies.lead: The portal uses strictly necessary cookies as well as, subject to your consent, audience measurement cookies.

paragraphs.p1: You can accept or refuse these cookies at any time from the dedicated banner, or from the cookie management page.

cookies.notice: The cookie management page precisely describes the cookie families used and their lifetime.
cookies.cta: Go to the cookie management page

meta.title: Terms of use
meta.description: The terms of use of the Bloctel portal.

hero.title: Terms of use
hero.lead: Access to and use of the Bloctel portal are subject to the terms set out below. By browsing the portal, you accept them.

objet.title: Purpose
objet.lead: The Bloctel portal is the institutional website of the Central Bank of the Republic of Astoria.

paragraphs.p1: It presents the missions of the Central Bank, monetary policy, official data and statistics, as well as the services offered to financial institutions, the State and citizens.
paragraphs.p2: These terms define the rules for using the portal and govern the liability of the publisher and of the user.

utilisation.title: Use of the portal
utilisation.lead: The portal is made available for information and public service purposes. Its use is free of charge.

bullets.b1: Content is provided for information purposes only and does not constitute legal, financial or professional advice.
bullets.b2: It is forbidden to use the portal for fraudulent, malicious or unlawful purposes.
bullets.b3: Any attempt to alter data or disrupt the service is prohibited.
bullets.b4: The publisher strives to ensure the accuracy of the published information, without guaranteeing the complete absence of errors.

contenus.title: Content and data
contenus.lead: Content published on the portal belongs to the Bloctel or to third-party rights holders.

paragraphs.p1: Unless otherwise stated, content (texts, data, images, tables) may be reused in accordance with the applicable public information reuse licence.
paragraphs.p2: The trademarks, logos and distinctive signs of the Central Bank and of the Republic of Astoria may not be reproduced without prior authorisation.

responsabilite.title: Liability
responsabilite.lead: The publisher does its best to ensure the availability and accuracy of the portal, within the limits of the available technical means.

paragraphs.p1: The publisher's liability cannot be engaged in the event of temporary interruption of the service, of links to third-party websites, or of inappropriate use of the published information.
paragraphs.p2: The user is responsible for the use they make of the portal's information and of the data they enter.

liens.title: Links
liens.lead: The portal may contain links to third-party websites, public or private.

paragraphs.p1: The publisher exercises no control over these websites and is not responsible for their content, accessibility or data protection practices.

modification.title: Modification of the terms
modification.lead: These terms may be modified at any time, in particular to reflect changes to the service.

paragraphs.p1: The applicable version is the one in force at the time of your browsing. Modified terms enter into force upon publication.

modification.notice: Any evolution of the portal gives rise to an update of this page.

meta.title: Cookie management
meta.description: The cookies used by the Bloctel portal and how to manage them.

hero.title: Cookie management
hero.lead: This page describes the cookies set by the Bloctel portal, their purpose and how to accept or refuse them.

definition.title: What is a cookie?
definition.lead: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit a website.

paragraphs.p1: Cookies store information about your browsing (preferences, language, audience measurement) to improve your experience and understand how the portal is used.
paragraphs.p2: The portal only sets strictly necessary cookies and, subject to your consent, audience measurement cookies. No advertising cookies are used.

cookiesDeposes.title: Cookies set by the portal
cookiesDeposes.lead: The table below lists the cookie families used by the portal and their retention period.

table.caption: Portal cookie inventory

1.1: Technical operation of the portal (browsing session)

3.1: Anonymised audience measurement, subject to your consent

table.note: Demonstration inventory: the final list of cookies will be published with the full rollout of the portal.

gestion.title: Manage your cookies
gestion.lead: You can accept or refuse non-essential cookies at any time, whichever method suits you best:

bullets.b1: From the cookie management banner, displayed on your first visit at the bottom left of the screen.
bullets.b2: By configuring your browser to refuse or delete cookies.
bullets.b3: By deleting the cookies already placed from your browser settings.

gestion.notice: Refusing audience measurement cookies does not affect how the portal works.
